warnings: This is an exact-byte offline analysis proposal, not approved firmware.
Applying these edits would invalidate the OEM signature; no signing or loading path is supplied.
The proposed source-converter private heaps exceed conservative reconstructed 6240/7424-byte bounds but have not been exercised in firmware.
The complete 48-to-192 and 192-to-48 SRC execution, deadlines, codec state, and physical bandwidth remain unqualified.

unresolved.required_resolution: Execute the 48-to-192 constructor through a supported firmware build and verify all private-heap allocations and returned status.
Execute the 192-to-48 constructor through a supported firmware build and verify all private-heap allocations and returned status.
Review constructor control flow and all allocation returns, then independently qualify clock, DMA, codec, timing, and acoustic bandwidth on supported firmware.

patch_set.summary: Unsigned, non-loadable and hardware-unqualified seven-edit in-place constructor/SRC proposal with statically bounded heaps; retained for exact offline review and complete mode qualification.

edits.semantic_intent: Candidate in-place rewrite of the complete 42-byte scratch initialization: preserve all stock non-size member stores and the null-DMA assertion arguments, set +0x2b4 to 1536 bytes, +0x2b8 to 3072 bytes and retain +0x2bc at 1536 bytes. The separate a14 size temporary is eliminated and the two 1536-byte stores precede the a15 doubling instruction.

edits.review_concern: Independent review passed for normal and null-DMA control flow, final store values, reordered independent member stores, temporary-register liveness, and exact fallthrough extent; the draft remains incomplete for runtime qualification.

edits.semantic_intent: Candidate replacement of the final board-predicate branch with a jump to 0x78972c05 so construction enters the existing high-rate topology on this board.
edits.review_concern: Forcing topology selection does not prove that the selected resources support 192 kHz.

edits.semantic_intent: Candidate change of the high-rate constructor value from 96 to 192 frames per millisecond while retaining the adjacent value 32; the later constructor stores this rate and derives four-slot BCLK and DMA geometry from it.
edits.review_concern: The arithmetic geometry is established, but device timing, converter initialization, and physical output are not.
